title: Covering gonality of hypersurfaces in a product of projective spaces
summary: In this work, we investigate the behaviour of the covering gonality of a very general hypersurface in a product of projective spaces. Inspired by the work of Bastianelli, Ciliberto, Flamini and Suppino in [BCFS19] which addresses the case of a hypersurface in a projective space, we establish a similar result for very general smooth hypersurfaces of sufficiently large bi-degree. More precisely, we show that the covering gonality of such hypersurfaces can be computed by viewing them as a family of hypersurfaces over a projective space.
